title: Pyongyang rejects Seoul's hypersonic test claims, justifies own arms buildup
caption:
A dispute over missile testing is escalating tensions. North Korea claims South Korea's new hypersonic weapon test was a failure based on the lack of burn marks, while Seoul stands by its advanced thermal materials.
